fit_set.method: sha256 (hex) over the UTF-8 bytes of one line per entry of the elements_of_record leaf, each line the entry's key (the arm_id, the leaf's own key), one tab character, then the entry's sha12; the lines sorted bytewise by key and each line followed by one newline character except the last (no trailing newline) — the identity of the SERVED SET, moving with every row added, replaced or re-bound; n_served_elements beside it is the count to check against the table's rows (fit-methods' word of 12:0xZ and its precision of 12:2xZ, 12 Oct 2026, on capability-vs-reliability's fact; fitting). set_sha256 and n_result_files keep their wave meaning: they count the posterior files in results_dir, not the served set.
fit_set.set_sha256_method: sha256 over sorted(basename + bytes) of the SERVED posterior_summary_*.json files (not_served stems excluded; n_arms counts the same files) — counts the posterior files in results_dir and not the served set, whose identity is served_elements_sha256 (12 Oct 2026)
